instruction: Set up an automatic forwarding rule in Thunderbird for the anonym-x2024@outlook.com account to forward all incoming messages to team-archive@gmail.com. Configure this locally in Thunderbird only.

metadata.explanation: Variation with different forward target email (team-archive@gmail.com). Evaluator verifies filter is enabled, action is Forward, target is team-archive@gmail.com, and condition is ALL. Same complexity as original.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts Thunderbird filter rules file from the appropriate account-specific path (outlook.office365.com folder for anonym-x2024@outlook.com)
Metric (check_thunderbird_filter) correctly parses filter rules and verifies all required properties: enabled, action, actionValue, and condition
Complete coverage: all instruction requirements are verified (account implicit in path, forward action, target email team-archive@gmail.com, all incoming messages via condition=ALL, rule enabled)
Expected values are semantically correct and match instruction requirements precisely
Postconfig appropriately closes Message Filters window to ensure clean state for verification
Robust error handling: metric returns 0.0 if file is missing or rules don't match
Data flow is logically sound: file extraction -> parsing -> rule matching -> boolean result

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_thunderbird_filter first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
